I (and others) encountered an issue where playlist queries returned empty results. At first, I thought it was because I had
playlist in extended m3u format. I found that the line skipping mechanism did not work correctly because the playlist file is read
as bytestrings and the comparator used regular strings.
Fixing that did not help (the previously unskipped lines were simply not found but did not break the search) and I then found

This PR continues the test suite's move from mixed string/bytes path handling to
The main architectural change is that shared test helpers now produce
, so tests can use one consistent path model end-to-end.
Tests are updated to prefer higher-level path APIs like
Supporting utilities were adjusted where needed, such as allowing

makes path handling in tests more consistent and readable
